metadata.note: Guideline tokens are partial overrides. Use resolvedTokens for fully merged theme values.

guidelines.name: void
guidelines.description: Absolute black. No borders, no shadows. Text at 40% opacity until interacted with.

guidelines.name: obsidian
guidelines.description: Deep warm charcoal with gold accents and sharp geometry.

guidelines.name: nightwatch
guidelines.description: Blue-black surfaces, electric cyan accent, monospace-first typography.

guidelines.name: pitch
guidelines.description: #050505 surfaces. White text only. A single accent color is the only chromatic signal.

guidelines.name: onyx
guidelines.description: Pure black, no borders. Drop shadows are the only depth signal.

guidelines.name: redshift
guidelines.description: Near-black with a deep crimson accent. Maximum contrast text.

guidelines.name: corvus
guidelines.description: Dark surfaces, indigo-violet accent, pill-radius geometry throughout.

guidelines.name: blackout
guidelines.description: Maximum dark. Neon chartreuse accent. Terminal lineage made modern.

guidelines.name: nightfall
guidelines.description: Warm dark (#100c0a), amber accent, editorial Manrope typography.

guidelines.name: carbon
guidelines.description: Zero hue. Pure neutral black-to-grey scale. Only luminance for hierarchy.

guidelines.name: phosphor
guidelines.description: Classic green phosphor on near-black. P1 screen feel.

guidelines.name: amber
guidelines.description: Orange-amber phosphor. VT100 warm display.

guidelines.name: vt220
guidelines.description: Cream-grey text on a dark warm grey. Classic serial terminal.

guidelines.name: c64
guidelines.description: Cornflower blue background, light blue text. Commodore heritage.

guidelines.name: ibm3270
guidelines.description: Dark green-teal on near-black. Mainframe glass-TTY.

guidelines.name: cpm
guidelines.description: White-on-black. Monospace-only. No rounded corners. Zero decoration.

guidelines.name: bbs
guidelines.description: Deep blue surfaces, bright ANSI palette accents. Bulletin board energy.

guidelines.name: eightbit
guidelines.description: Hard pixel edges. Limited flat palette. No gradients, no blur.

guidelines.name: teletype
guidelines.description: Warm off-white on near-black. Mechanical typewriter inspiration.

guidelines.name: dithered
guidelines.description: Monochrome only. Opacity patterns simulate depth. No color whatsoever.

guidelines.name: midnight
guidelines.description: Deep indigo surfaces, neon lavender accent. Late-night creative session.

guidelines.name: aurora
guidelines.description: Dark base, gradient-kissed teal-to-violet accents. Northern lights palette.

guidelines.name: solstice
guidelines.description: Dark warm navy, gold accent. Heavy editorial Manrope typography.

guidelines.name: infrared
guidelines.description: Dark surfaces, vivid orange-red accent. Bold and urgent.

guidelines.name: ultraviolet
guidelines.description: Near-black with electric purple. Neon-glow card borders.

guidelines.name: plasma
guidelines.description: Deep magenta-dark surface, cyan accent. High-energy contrast.

guidelines.name: bioluminescence
guidelines.description: Black base, soft cyan-green glow on interactive elements.

guidelines.name: neon-noir
guidelines.description: Dark cool-grey surface, hot pink accent. Film noir relit by neon.

guidelines.name: velvet
guidelines.description: Deep purple-black, rose-gold accent. Soft, luxurious.

guidelines.name: cinema
guidelines.description: Warm-black surfaces, cream text, letterbox-inspired spacing.

guidelines.name: studio-grey
guidelines.description: Medium-dark grey. White text. Zero decoration. Typography carries everything.

guidelines.name: monolith
guidelines.description: Single grey scale. Strong typographic hierarchy. No accent color.

guidelines.name: paper
guidelines.description: Light mode: off-white surfaces, dark grey text. The IDE in daylight.

guidelines.name: blueprint
guidelines.description: Deep technical blue, engineering drawing aesthetic. Grid-line borders.

guidelines.name: manuscript
guidelines.description: Off-white light mode, Lexend as primary font. Long-form reading feel.

guidelines.name: nordic
guidelines.description: Cool blue-grey dark surfaces. Icy blue accent. Scandinavian restraint.

guidelines.name: graphite
guidelines.description: Warm charcoal. Zero accent hue. Pure neutrals only.

guidelines.name: wire
guidelines.description: Dark base, outline-only components. Everything is drawn, not filled.

guidelines.name: fieldwork
guidelines.description: Mid-dark earthy surfaces. Muted sage-green accent. Grounded.

guidelines.name: calibration
guidelines.description: OS system-UI aesthetic. No personality. All function.

guidelines.name: forest
guidelines.description: Deep green-black surfaces, bright verdant accent.

guidelines.name: ocean
guidelines.description: Deep teal-black, aqua accent. Pressure and depth.

guidelines.name: dusk
guidelines.description: Warm dark purple-to-orange. Twilight gradient accents.

guidelines.name: ember
guidelines.description: Deep red-brown surfaces, glowing ember-orange accent.

guidelines.name: moss
guidelines.description: Dark olive surfaces, muted yellow-green text. Still and earthy.

guidelines.name: volcanic
guidelines.description: Near-black with deep-lava orange accents. Slow-burn energy.

guidelines.name: arctic
guidelines.description: Very dark blue-black, ice-white accent. Cold and precise.

guidelines.name: verdant
guidelines.description: Dark cool-green surfaces, electric lime accent.

guidelines.name: terracotta
guidelines.description: Warm dark clay-brown surfaces, dusty orange accent.

guidelines.name: deep-sea
guidelines.description: Absolute black-teal, dim cyan-green bioluminescent accents.

guidelines.name: cyberpunk
guidelines.description: Dark purple base, electric yellow + hot magenta dual accent.

guidelines.name: synthwave
guidelines.description: Warm dark-magenta surfaces, neon pink and cyan. Retrowave palette.

guidelines.name: hologram
guidelines.description: Semi-transparent layered surfaces. Iridescent, ghostly accent.

guidelines.name: neural
guidelines.description: Very dark, subtle electric-blue pulse borders. AI inner monologue.

guidelines.name: matrix
guidelines.description: Dark, cascading-green data aesthetic. #00FF41.

guidelines.name: axiom
guidelines.description: Clean white-on-dark sci-fi. Geometric, institutional.

guidelines.name: void-pulse
guidelines.description: Black surfaces. Single electric-blue accent that flickers on interaction.

guidelines.name: terraform
guidelines.description: Dark cool slate, system-orange accent. Infrastructure-layer aesthetic.

guidelines.name: hyperspace
guidelines.description: Deep blue-black. Streaking white-blue accents suggest velocity.

guidelines.name: singularity
guidelines.description: Maximum contrast: pure black, pure white text, one neon accent. Nothing else.
